skill.description: Generate an evidence-backed onboarding guide from a repository and its operational surfaces.

memory.responsibility: Retain repository map plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform runtime surfaces into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through domain concepts while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only repository, runtime, and verification capabilities required by the bounded engineering task.

stages: Identify entry points and ownership areas
Map build test and deployment paths

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
